name: merge-brainstorm direction params (v4)
role: Steering parameters for the MERGE-BRAINSTORM niche-finding engine. They bias the generator toward human-blind combinatorial corners by maximizing cognitive distance and structural surprise of merges. These are the 'trained params' that DRIVE exploration. They do NOT gate novelty: the separate checker uses search ONLY for anti-cheating (hallucination + pretrained-regurgitation), never to disqualify a construct for 'already existing' (R7/R12).

engine_contract.the_engine_is: merge-brainstorm: merge maximally distant concepts into a NEW construct that human researchers would not naturally reach because the parents live in unrelated domains.
engine_contract.the_win_is: a genuine merge that reaches a human-blind corner. Adjacency to prior work is NOT a penalty (R10).
engine_contract.search_is: a last-resort INTEGRITY check run by a SEPARATE agent. It verifies the construct was genuinely merged (not hallucinated, not regurgitated from pretraining). It is never a novelty gate.

objective_weights._note: scoring = w·features; used by the engine to steer generation and by phase-4 ranking (cognitive_distance × structural_generativity × mechanism_concreteness).

merge_operators.desc: carry the structural skeleton of parent A onto the substrate of parent B (e.g. a queueing discipline becomes an attention schedule).
take a constraint that defines parent A and invert it inside parent B's dynamics.
run parent A's process on a substrate it was never meant for (parent B's material/medium).
import the time-evolution / update rule of A into the state space of B.
measure B using a metric/geometry native to A (e.g. an ecological diversity index over latent features).
erase the boundary that separates A and B, then ask what single object both become.
swap which parent is the actor and which is the environment.
apply A's small-scale rule at B's large scale (or vice versa) and keep the rule, change the scale.

estimate_parent_distance_by: different ontological category (process vs object vs relation vs constraint vs metric)
different characteristic scale (microsecond vs generational; molecule vs society)
absence of literature co-occurrence (the parents are not normally discussed together)
distance_heuristic.favor: parents that score HIGH on as many distance axes as possible.
distance_heuristic.penalize_for_steering_only: parents from the same sub-field (low distance) — they produce obvious, non-corner merges.

corner_targeting.triple_form: X (tech) × Y (life) × Z (distant third, tech or life) — favor X×Y×Z over X×Y (R9).
corner_targeting.cross_substrate_rule: at least one parent from tech_bank and one from life_bank, so the merge crosses the technical/experiential divide.
corner_targeting.avoid: parent pairs that already co-occur in the literature (those corners are not human-blind).
corner_targeting.target: the combinatorial corners human cognition skips because the parents are filed under unrelated mental categories.

per_construct: what_it_produces (a prediction/method/object neither parent yields alone)
human_blind_spot_reason (WHY humans would not reach this corner)
generation_trace (the merge reasoning, so the checker can verify genuine merge vs pretrained recall)
generation_requirements.trace_requirement: generation_trace MUST show parent selection + operator + step-by-step derivation. A construct without a real derivation trace is indistinguishable from recall and will be flagged in phase 3.
generation_requirements.research_relevance_hint: this repo mines AI/LLM/computational research niches; favor constructs whose what_it_produces is a candidate research direction (method, prediction, measurable object), reached via a distant life-side parent.

anti_cheating_contract.params_reward: genuine merging (distance + surprise + concrete mechanism + real trace).
anti_cheating_contract.never: do not use search as a novelty gate; do not conclude 'saturated'; present genuine merges for human judgment (R12/R14).

changelog.change: added cross_substrate_rule (tech×life) and generation_trace requirement to make merges checker-verifiable.
hardened anti_cheating_contract per R7/R12/R13: search is integrity-only; adjacency to prior work is never penalized; distinguish genuine-merge-near-prior (PASS) from regurgitated-existing (FLAG).
